trace_function_make_fx: trace a function into an FX graph using make_fx with real, fake, or symbolic tracing modes
dispatch_trace_module: dispatch trace an nn.Module or callable with a custom Tracer to produce a GraphModule
run_decomposition_interpreter: run a DecompositionInterpreter on a GraphModule to decompose ops using a decomposition table
proxy_dispatch_torch_ops: proxy torch dispatch ops through ProxyTorchDispatchMode to trace tensor operations into an FX graph
get_isolated_graphmodule: get an isolated GraphModule for a function by detaching args from the current tracer context
